info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Application Status API provides a means to access the current status of job applications submitted by candidates. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding the progression of their applications, thereby enhancing the transparency of the recruitment process. Typical consumers include job seekers and HR personnel who need to track application statuses efficiently. By integrating this API, organizations can improve candidate communication and streamline the hiring workflow.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of applications in the system. Use this to check if applications are in progress, completed, or have any issues that need addressing.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the current status of applications. The body should conform to the specified JSON schema, which outlines the structure of the expected request data.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusRequest.description: A request body identifier for operations related to status in the applications API.
